name: Memo
instructions: You can persist short notes for the user with the memo tools (memo_save/memo_list/memo_clear), which survive across sessions. When the user asks you to remember something, save it; when they ask what they told you to remember, list it. Use run_background to kick off a long task without blocking the chat.

tools.description: Spawn a background agent task with the given prompt.

prompt.description: What the background agent should do.
